Drop a local Phaser 3 build here as phaser.min.js to enable the embedded Boss Hunt scene.
Suggested file name:
  /ui/assets/vendor/phaser.min.js

How to get it:
- Download Phaser 3 from the official Phaser repository or npm package.
- Copy the built dist file into this folder.

The app still runs without Phaser; it falls back to a built-in canvas renderer.
